title: A write that waits for a person
goal: {{castAgentId}} at {{castBrand}} wants to open {{castTicket}} through open_ticket, a tool that changes data.
obstacle: A permitted write is still a write. An organisation may want a person to approve it first.
control: In this simulation the gateway holds the call until {{castApprover}} approves it in the console. The verdict is Held, nothing ran, and the body is invented by this lab and labelled simulated.
say: The call is held, not refused and not run. This is a simulation: nobody has captured a real held call yet, so Real never claims one.

steps.title: Run the write tool
steps.tell: On demo-all-tools, select open_ticket and run it. The verdict is Held and the card says the hold is simulated.
steps.why: The held-call body here is the lab's invention. A real held-call shape needs an owner capture.

steps.title: Look at the hops
steps.tell: Open the reel. The last gateway hop shows the call held and the approval hop is the lab's simulation of a person's decision. Nothing was approved and nothing ran.
steps.say: The approval step is drawn for teaching and is labelled simulated.
steps.why: A client cannot see inside a real gateway, so the lab never presents a simulated hop as something it observed.
